answer: Randomized Assignment Slots. Each epoch, a verifiable random beacon assigns agents to work slots; only assigned agents earn, and assignment is revealed after commit. Attacker identities scatter like a plume but rarely land slots, so each fake identity costs full registration plus idle cycles before any payoff. Colluding clusters face a canyon of missed epochs. To forge reliable coverage they must run many identities continuously, paying compute and latency per identity with no guaranteed return.
